title: Bill negotiator posing as the customer - Taylor Brooks
summary: A bill-negotiation service calls as if it were the customer, to get a discount. The voice is human, so a deepfake detector alone would let it through. The voiceprint says it is not Taylor, the number has called about 37 accounts this week, and the caller cannot answer a question from the account history.

voices.caller: Real human voice, not the account holder: LibriSpeech test-clean speaker 1580 (CC BY 4.0)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling, this is Ryan. I see you'd like to talk about your bill. Am I speaking with the account holder, Taylor Brooks?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Taylor. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Above all things, I desire to settle the matter quietly and discreetly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. I can review your plan, but I can't promise a discount or a credit.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You don't seem to realize the position.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand you may leave us. Before I look at offers, one quick question from your account history. Which phone did you get from us in April?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh, I would not venture to say, sir.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you calling on someone else's behalf, for example a bill negotiation service?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. As I can't verify you as the account holder, I can't change the plan or add credits on this call. Taylor can call us directly, or add an authorized contact in the app.
